guide: Open Start and type your agency name and your targets in the yellow cells: the late limit in minutes, the late and missed targets, the time now and the mileage rate.
Check Caregivers, Clients, Services, Areas, Travel Times and Team. A caregiver is a carer, care worker or support worker. A one-person agency can keep only a few rows.
Log each visit on Visit Log with the check-in and check-out times typed or pasted from whatever you use; there is no app and no GPS. Minutes late, hours worked, billable hours and the flag fill in.
Each morning open Today Check-ins, type the time now in Start and read the call-first rank; Who to Call Today lists the five visits to phone about.
Record every late or missed visit on Late and Missed Register with the reason, the phoning and whether the client was told; repeat caregivers are flagged.
Keep Caregiver Hours by Week, Agency Hours by Week and Client Hours by Month up to date; the leak is the money paid for hours that were not billed.
Log travel legs on Mileage Log. Travel by Area Pair and the Visit Pair Sharing and Area Clustering tools show where one caregiver can take two visits.
Before each pay run use Time Sheet Check: a difference above the tolerance is queried. Pay, overtime and payroll taxes: check your own local rules and confirm with your adviser.
Record corrections, client cancellations and overlong visits so the unbilled money and the notice rules are visible.
Use the 18 decision tools: each ends with a verdict and a what-if table. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready messages.
Why a workbook: one flat price, no per-client or per-caregiver fee, and your data stays with you. A one-person agency can start with Visit Log, Time Sheet Check and Mileage Log.
Read the Visits KPI Dashboard and Charts every week: late rate, missed rate, hours delivered, billed and paid, the leak and travel.

listing.title: Home Care Agency Visit Tracker Excel Template: Late and Missed Visits, Billed vs Paid Hours, Mileage, Time Sheets, KPI Dashboard
listing.headline: See late visits, hour leaks and travel cost in one Excel file
listing.description:
Compare what was scheduled with what happened, visit by visit, in one Excel workbook built for a small non-medical home care agency run by an owner-director, a scheduler, an office manager and field supervisors. A one-person start-up agency can use the Visit Log, Time Sheet Check and Mileage Log pages as its own time sheet.

Visit Log takes check-in and check-out times typed or pasted from whatever you use (there is no app, no GPS and no automatic check-in) and works out minutes late, hours worked, billable hours and a Late, Short, Long or Missed flag. Today Check-ins ranks the visits without a check-in so you know who to phone first. Late and Missed Register records the reason, the phoning and whether the client was told, and flags repeat cases. Agency Hours by Week sets hours delivered against billed against paid and puts the leak in money. Area Performance by Month shows which area runs late.

18 decision tools answer weekly questions with a verdict and a what-if table: scheduled against actual, who to call today, late and missed rate, area problem finder, leak by cause, mileage claim check, visit pair sharing, area clustering saving, time sheet reconciliation, rounding rule test, missed visit cost and more. Print 12 sheets and 12 documents, follow 12 checklists and send 34 ready text messages.

This is part three of the Home Care Agency Business suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, one flat price with no per-client or per-caregiver fee, your data stays with you, 15 languages in one purchase, and a demo copy full of sample data. The workbook holds dates, times, hours and amounts only, never care notes, and it does not promise results.

We are arranging another visit and will phone you to agree the time. Thank you for your patience. Reference {col:register.visit_id}.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own agency and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Area performance report
paragraphs: Area performance report of {set:company}, dated {today}. Area: {col:areamonths.area}. Month: {col:areamonths.month}.
Visits {col:areamonths.visits}, late {col:areamonths.late_visits} (rate {col:areamonths.late_rate}), missed {col:areamonths.missed_visits} (rate {col:areamonths.missed_rate}).

Late rate of the area over the last 2 months: {col:areamonths.late_rate_2m}. Target: {set:late_visit_target}. Paid travel hours {col:areamonths.travel_hours}, travel cost {col:areamonths.travel_cost}, travel share of pay {col:areamonths.travel_share}.
Decisions for the area are written below.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own agency and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Billed against paid hours report: the leak
paragraphs: Billed against paid hours report of {set:company}, dated {today}. Week of {col:agencyweeks.week}.
Delivered hours {col:agencyweeks.delivered_hours}, billed hours {col:agencyweeks.billed_hours}, paid hours {col:agencyweeks.paid_hours}. Billed minus paid hours: {col:agencyweeks.billed_minus_paid}.

Hours paid above billed: {col:agencyweeks.paid_over_billed}. Average pay rate {col:agencyweeks.avg_pay_rate}. Leak amount at loaded pay: {col:agencyweeks.leak_amount}. Payroll burden: {set:payroll_burden} (confirm with your adviser).
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own agency and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Travel pair plan for two areas
paragraphs: Travel pair plan of {set:company}, dated {today}. From {col:pairs.from_area} to {col:pairs.to_area}.
Over 12 months: {col:pairs.legs} legs, {col:pairs.minutes} paid minutes, {col:pairs.km} km, cost {col:pairs.cost}. Cost per leg {col:pairs.cost_per_leg}, {col:pairs.min_per_leg} minutes per leg.
Plan: give both visits of the pair to one caregiver when the gap allows. Use the Visit Pair Sharing tool to check the saving.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own agency and check your own local rules.

documents.title: Monthly hours statement for a caregiver
paragraphs: Hours statement of {set:company}, dated {today}. Caregiver: {col:caregivers.name}, {col:caregivers.employment}.
Hours worked in the last 4 weeks: {col:caregivers.worked_4w}. Paid travel hours: {col:caregivers.travel_4w}. Visits in the last 30 days: {col:caregivers.visits_30d}.
Pay rate per hour: {col:caregivers.pay_rate}. Pay, overtime and payroll taxes: check your own local rules and confirm with your adviser.
